title: Gauge project-shape profile v1
description: Declares where a source's jig-style artifacts live (ADR-0009). Config-inline home only in v1 (slice 007-01); a project with no profile normalizes to these same defaults.

artifactRoot.description: Path, relative to the project root, under which specs/decisions live.

specsDir.description: Folder name, relative to artifactRoot, holding spec directories.

decisionsDir.description: Folder name, relative to artifactRoot, holding ADR files.

statusProperty.description: Frontmatter property name carrying jig status (unexercised by the current corpus; ADR-0009 A3).

entries.description: Optional multi-entry decomposition (ADR-0009 D2, slice 007-02): one repository expands into N portfolio entries, each with its own artifact root. When present, entries define the portfolio entries; the top-level artifactRoot applies only to the no-entries single-entry case.

id.description: Entry id, combined with the project's base id as `<baseId>-<entryId>` (must stay within the project id pattern; enforced at config-normalization time).

label.description: Display label for this entry's portfolio card.

artifactRoot.description: Path, relative to the project root, under which this entry's specs/decisions live.

specsDir.description: Folder name, relative to this entry's artifactRoot, holding spec directories. Defaults to the profile's specsDir, then 'specs'.

decisionsDir.description: Folder name, relative to this entry's artifactRoot, holding ADR files. Defaults to the profile's decisionsDir, then 'decisions'.

statusProperty.description: Frontmatter property name carrying jig status for this entry. Defaults to the profile's statusProperty, then 'status'.
